svg.title: Tracing with AWS X-Ray
svg.desc: The group server on Fargate generates traces with the ADOT SDK for Go; the SFU server on EC2 generates them at its Envoy proxy. Both send traces to an OpenTelemetry Collector container, which exports them to AWS X-Ray to build the service map.
svg.text: Trace IDs start at the group server and at the SFU's Envoy proxy.
